title: Where Are the Vibecoded Photoshops?
summary: A reflective blog post questioning why, despite the vibecoding revolution (AI-assisted rapid prototyping), there aren't more professional-grade applications like Photoshop-level tools emerging. It explores the gap between AI coding tool hype and actual production-quality software output.
problem_solved: Questions whether AI-assisted coding tools have actually delivered on their promise of enabling individuals to build professional-grade software quickly.
why_valuable: Provides critical perspective on the vibecoding phenomenon by examining the disconnect between tool capability and real-world software quality.
